name: Sticky header
looksLike: top strip that stays visible while I scroll
page heading stuck to the top as content moves
navigation that follows me down the page
definition: A header that stays at the top of its scroll container after reaching a specified position while the page continues scrolling beneath it.
whenToUse: Keeping navigation available on long pages
Retaining important page actions during scrolling

notConfusedWith.difference: Describes a navigation component; it may scroll away or be placed inside a sticky header.

prompts.short: Add a sticky header that stays visible on scroll without hiding focused content.
prompts.detailed: Add a compact header using position: sticky and top: 0, with an opaque background and suitable stacking order. Keep its links keyboard accessible with 44px targets. Account for its height with scroll padding or target scroll margins so anchor destinations and focused controls remain visible.

html: <!-- Add this header near the start of body, outside a short or overflow-clipped ancestor. -->
<!-- Set page scroll-padding-top to the rendered header height, including when links wrap. -->

a11yNotes: Do not obscure keyboard focus or anchor destinations
Keep navigation targets at least 44px high
Avoid large sticky regions that consume the screen when zoomed
